name: Firing Deck 12
summary: Firing Deck X: in your Shooting phase, when this TRANSPORT is selected to shoot, up to X (here 12) embarked models each lend it one of their ranged weapons (not one-shot) for its attacks; those models' units cannot shoot again this phase.

name: A Hearty ‘Pick Me Up’
summary: While leading a unit, in your Command phase you can return up to D3 destroyed models to that unit.

name: Ablative Plating
summary: Once per battle, when an attack is allocated to this model, you can set that attack's Damage characteristic to 0.

name: Aeronautica Commander
summary: At the start of your Shooting phase, mark one enemy unit within 30" of and visible to this unit's Officer of the Fleet model; friendly Astra Militarum Aircraft attacks against it get +1 to Hit for the rest of the phase.

name: Agile Dogfighter
summary: Attacks targeting this model suffer -1 to the Hit roll.

name: Airborne Insertion
summary: At the end of the opponent's Movement phase, units embarked within this Transport can disembark.

name: Alchemyk Counteragents
summary: The bearer's unit has the Feel No Pain 6+ ability against mortal wounds.

name: Ancient Conquest
summary: This model re-rolls Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1 on attacks against enemy units within the opponent's deployment zone.

name: Anti-armour Gunship
summary: This model re-rolls Damage rolls of 1 on ranged attacks allocated to a Monster or Vehicle model.

name: Aquiline Prow
summary: After this unit ends a Charge move, roll a D6 against one enemy unit within Engagement Range: 2-3 deals D3 mortal wounds, 4-5 deals 3, 6 deals D3+3.

name: Armour Obliteration
summary: When this model's quake cannon destroys an enemy model with the Deadly Demise ability, that ability triggers mortal wounds on a D6 roll of 3+ instead of 6.

name: Armoured Aggressor
summary: This model's ranged attacks do not suffer the usual Hit roll penalty for being within Engagement Range of enemy units.

name: Armoured Defender
summary: When targeted with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem, this model scores hits on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+ while resolving it.

name: Armoured Frontis
summary: Attacks allocated to this model have their Damage characteristic reduced by 1.

name: Armoured Spearhead
summary: This model's attacks re-roll Hit rolls of 1, or the whole Hit roll instead if targeting a unit within range of an objective marker you do not control.

name: Artillery Commander
summary: At the start of your Shooting phase, mark one visible enemy unit within 30" of this unit's Master of Ordnance (once per phase); friendly Artillery Blast weapons gain Sustained Hits 1 against it for the phase.

name: ARTILLERY TEAM
summary: Place three Crew tokens when this model is set up, removing one each time it loses a wound; the model itself represents its final wound.

name: ATTACHÉS
summary: At Declare Battle Formations, this unit must join a Command Squad (only one per squad) and becomes part of it, raising its Starting Strength, and may embark in any Transport that unit can; if it cannot join, it is destroyed before battle.

name: Auspex Surveyor
summary: After this model shoots, pick one hit enemy unit; until the end of the phase it has no Benefit of Cover.

name: Battlefield Control
summary: This model re-rolls Hit rolls of 1 on ranged attacks made while within range of an objective marker it controls.

name: Battlefield Dominance
summary: This model's ranged weapons gain the Ignores Cover ability against targets within half range.

name: Been There, Seen it, Killed it
summary: If this model made a Charge move this turn, its melee attacks can re-roll the Hit roll and the Wound roll.

name: Blistering Advance
summary: Units may disembark from this Transport after it Advances; they count as having made a Normal move and cannot declare a charge that turn.

name: Bomb Drop
summary: After a Normal move, roll six D6 against one enemy unit this model moved over: each 3+ deals 1 mortal wound.

name: Bring it Down!
summary: This unit's ranged attacks against Monster or Vehicle units re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1.

name: Brutal Disciplinarian
summary: Once per turn, select one Battle-shocked friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit (more than 1 model) within 12": destroy one model in it and it is no longer Battle-shocked.

name: Brute Shield
summary: The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save.

name: Cadia Stands!
summary: While this unit contains an OFFICER and is within range of an objective, it can re-roll Battle-shock rolls.

name: Called Shots
summary: Once when selected to shoot, this model can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll, and one Damage roll among its attacks.

name: Close-quarters Warfare
summary: This model does not suffer the Hit roll penalty for making ranged attacks while enemy units are within its Engagement Range.

name: Close-range Devastation
summary: This model's Stormblade plasma blastgun can re-roll the Hit roll when targeting a unit within half range.

name: Close-range Titan Killer
summary: This model's magma cannon always treats Monster and Vehicle targets as being within half range.

name: Cold Steel and Courage
summary: While leading a unit, melee weapons of models in it gain the Lethal Hits ability.

name: Command Rod
summary: While leading a unit, that unit can be affected by up to two different Orders simultaneously.

name: COMPACT
summary: This model can embark within an Astra Militarum Transport as an Infantry model, taking up the space of 7 models.

name: Concussive Wave
summary: After choosing a target for this model's siege cannon, roll a D6 for that unit and each unit within 3" of it: on a 5+, it is struck by a concussive wave and suffers D3 mortal wounds after this model finishes attacking.

name: Convoy Escort Vehicle
summary: After this unit shoots, it can make a Normal move of up to D6"; if it does, it cannot declare a charge for the rest of the turn.

name: Counterstrategist
summary: At the end of the opponent's Movement phase, pick an enemy unit that moved within 9" and an idle friendly Regiment unit within 6": that unit can move D6", surge toward the enemy, or shoot it (only unmodified 6s hit).

name: Covering Fire
summary: When targeted with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem, this unit scores hits on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+ (4+ instead if within 6" of a friendly Platoon unit, for some variants).

name: Covert Stealth Team
summary: At the end of your opponent's turn, if unengaged, this unit can enter strategic reserves with Deep Strike (until your next Shooting phase) and must make an ingress move next Movement phase (including turn one).

name: Daring Recon
summary: At the start of your Shooting phase, mark one enemy unit within 18" and visible to this unit; friendly Astra Militarum attacks against it re-roll Hit rolls of 1 for the rest of the phase.

name: Death Befitting An Officer
summary: When this unit is destroyed by shooting, before its deadly demise roll, roll one D6: on a 2+ it is not removed yet and can shoot back at the attacker; it is then removed after shooting (or end of phase) once its deadly demise roll resolves.

name: Death Korps Medi-pack
summary: At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer's unit is below Starting Strength, return up to D3 destroyed Troopers to it (D3+1 if the unit has two bearers of this item).

name: Deathstrike Missile
summary: Once per battle when selected to shoot, instead of resolving other ranged attacks with this weapon this model can place a unique target marker anywhere on the battlefield, or move an existing one.

name: Decisive Command
summary: This model's next Order can target a unit within 12"; if it is the first Order issued this Command phase, it also affects every other eligible friendly unit within 6" of that unit.

name: Defence Line
summary: While an Infantry model has the Benefit of Cover from this fortification, it also has a 4+ invulnerable save.

name: Defence Searchlight
summary: At the start of your Shooting phase, pick one enemy unit within 24" and visible to the bearer; until the end of the phase it has no Benefit of Cover.

name: Demolition Charges
summary: When this model or an enemy unit ends a move within 3" of the other, this model is destroyed; instead of its normal Deadly Demise roll, roll a D6 against the chosen enemy unit: 2-5 deals D3 mortal wounds, 6 deals D6.

name: Demolition Gear
summary: The bearer's unit gains the Grenades keyword.

name: Desert Riders
summary: This unit can ignore modifiers to its Move characteristic and to its Advance and Charge rolls, and is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn it Fell Back.

name: Divination (Psychic)
summary: Enemy Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" of this unit's Astropath model.

name: Earthshaker Rounds
summary: After this model's earthshaker cannon hits an enemy Infantry unit, that unit is shaken for a time (varies by model): shaken units suffer -2" Move and -2 to Charge rolls, and to Advance rolls on some variants.

name: EMBARKING
summary: While embarked within a Transport, each model of this type takes up the space of 2 models, and its weapon counts as belonging to 2 models for the Firing Deck ability.

name: Emplacement Platform
summary: Friendly Astra Militarum Infantry models can be set up or end any move on top of this fortification's platform section.

name: Explosive Death
summary: When this model is destroyed, roll a D6: on a 3+, before being removed it can shoot its inferno gun as if at full wounds after the attacker finishes, in your Shooting phase.

name: Fiery Vengeance
summary: Once per turn, if a friendly Astra Militarum unit within 6" is destroyed by a Fly-capable attacker's shooting, this model can shoot back at that attacker afterward, as if it were your Shooting phase.

name: Final Duty
summary: While the Fire Coordinator model is on the battlefield, when a Heavy Weapons Gunner model in this unit is destroyed, roll a D6: on a 3+ it shoots back after the attacker before being removed from play.

name: Flak Battery
summary: This model re-rolls Hit rolls on attacks against a unit that can Fly.

name: Flush Them Out
summary: After this model shoots, pick one enemy unit it hit; until your next Shooting phase it has no Benefit of Cover.

name: Furious Barrage
summary: After shooting, mark one hit non-Monster/Vehicle enemy unit staggered until your next Shooting phase: -1 Objective Control (minimum 1). Some variants instead re-roll Hit rolls against units of five or more models.

name: Get Back in the Fight
summary: While leading a unit, that unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

name: GRENADIER SQUAD
summary: A Leader-ability model normally eligible to join a Death Korps of Krieg unit can attach to this unit instead.

name: Grenadiers
summary: Once per turn, you can target this unit with the Explosives Stratagem for 0CP.

name: Grim Demeanour
summary: This unit's attacks get +1 to Hit if the unit is below Starting Strength, and +1 to Wound as well if it is Below Half-strength.

name: Grim Determination
summary: While this unit includes an Officer, it can be targeted with Stratagems and keeps the benefit of Orders even while Battle-shocked.

name: Gung-ho Command
summary: While this unit includes an Officer, ranged weapons equipped by models in it gain the Assault ability.

name: Gung-ho Executioners
summary: This model's executioner plasma cannon gets +1 to the Hit roll when targeting a Below Half-strength unit.

name: Gunship Barrage
summary: After this model shoots, pick one hit enemy unit; it must take a Battle-shock test.

name: Harker’s Hellraisers
summary: While leading a unit, ranged attacks against it from more than 12" away suffer -1 to the Hit roll.

name: Heavy Bombs
summary: After a Normal move, roll nine D6 against one enemy unit this model moved over (+1 per die if that unit is a Monster or Vehicle): each 5+ deals 1 mortal wound.

name: Hero of Hades Hive
summary: In your Command phase, choose one Hero of Hades Hive ability for this model to have until your next Command phase.

name: Heroic Example
summary: While this unit's Minka Lesk model is on the battlefield, this unit's attacks can re-roll the Hit roll.

name: Holy Piety
summary: Unless this model's unit is Battle-shocked, its melee attacks can re-roll the Hit roll.

name: Horsemasters
summary: This unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

name: Icon of Discipline
summary: This model's unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

name: Independent Operatives
summary: An Order issued to this unit continues to affect it until a new Order is issued, it becomes Battle-shocked, or the battle ends.

name: Inferno Bombs
summary: After a Normal move, roll nine D6 against one enemy unit this model moved over (+1 per die if that unit is not a Monster or Vehicle): each 5+ deals 1 mortal wound.

name: Inspiring Hero (Aura)
summary: While a friendly Astra Militarum unit is within 6" of this model, its Battle-shock and Leadership tests can be re-rolled.

name: Jungle Fighters
summary: If this unit made a Charge move or was charged this turn, its melee attacks get +1 to the Wound roll.

name: Leading the Charge
summary: When this model's unit makes a Charge move, its melee weapons gain the Devastating Wounds ability until the end of the turn.

name: Lesk’s Heroes
summary: This unit's Leadership characteristic is increased by 1, and its Battle-shock and Leadership tests can be re-rolled.

name: Like Fighting a Shadow
summary: After this model shoots, if it is outside Engagement Range of all enemies, it can make a Normal move; if it does, it cannot declare a charge for the rest of the turn.

name: Line-breaker
summary: This model's named weapon can target enemy units within its own Engagement Range if no other friendly unit is also engaged with them, and it ignores the ranged Hit roll penalty for being within Engagement Range.

name: LONER
summary: This model cannot be selected as your Warlord.

name: Lord Castellan
summary: While leading a unit, that unit can be affected by up to two different Orders simultaneously.

name: LOYAL PROTECTOR
summary: At Declare Battle Formations, this model must join a Command Squad (one per squad), raising its Starting Strength and taking up 3 models' space when embarked; it cannot be Warlord, and if it cannot join, it is destroyed before battle.

name: Malign Wardings(Psychic)
summary: While leading a unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against Psychic Attacks.

name: Mark the Target
summary: Each time this unit Remains Stationary, its ranged weapons gain the Devastating Wounds ability until the start of your next Movement phase.

name: Master Vox
summary: This unit's Officer can issue Orders to eligible units up to 24" away.

name: Mechanised Spearhead
summary: In your Movement phase, when a friendly Regiment unit disembarks from a Transport within 6" of this model, this model can issue it an extra Order beyond its normal limit.

name: Medi-pack
summary: At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer's unit is below Starting Strength, return up to D3 destroyed non-CHARACTER Platoon models to it.

name: Medicae Medi-packs
summary: While this unit includes a Medicae Servitor model, models in it have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

name: Melta Mine
summary: Once per battle, at the start of any phase, target one enemy unit within 3" of the bearer and roll a D6: on a 2+ it suffers D3 mortal wounds (2D3 instead against a Vehicle).

name: Meteoric Descent
summary: When this model uses Deep Strike, it can set up more than 6" (rather than 8") from all enemies, but cannot charge that turn.

name: Mobile Command Vehicle
summary: In your Command phase, an embarked Officer can issue Orders, measured to and from this Transport, without being on the battlefield.

name: Mobile Hunter-killer
summary: This model re-rolls Wound rolls on attacks against Monster or Vehicle units.

name: Mobile Hunter-killers
summary: This unit's attacks against Monster or Vehicle units can re-roll the Wound roll.

name: Mount Up!
summary: At the end of the opponent's Movement phase, if empty, this Transport can embark one friendly Astra Militarum Infantry unit (excluding Artillery) wholly within 6" of it, unless that unit is within Engagement Range of an enemy.

name: Mow Down the Enemy
summary: This model's punisher gatling cannon gains the Devastating Wounds ability against non-Monster/Vehicle targets.

name: Ogryn Bodyguard
summary: While an Officer model is in the same unit as this model, that Officer has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

name: One-man Army
summary: Once per turn in the opponent's Shooting phase, when a friendly Regiment unit within 3" of this model is shot, this model can shoot back at the attacker afterward, as if it were your Shooting phase.

name: ORDERS
summary: This Officer can issue one or more Orders to units of specified types (such as Regiment, Squadron, or Titanic); the exact number of Orders and eligible unit types vary by model.

name: Outflank
summary: When this model arrives from Strategic Reserves, it can be set up within the opponent's deployment zone (other restrictions still apply).

name: Overwhelming Short-range Firepower
summary: This model's attacks against the closest eligible enemy unit re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1.

name: Payback Time
summary: Once per battle when selected to shoot, this model's Payback weapon gains +6 Attacks and Sustained Hits 3 (instead of Sustained Hits 1) for the rest of the phase.

name: Pinning Bombardment
summary: After this model shoots, if its named weapon hit an enemy Infantry unit, that unit must take a Battle-shock test.

name: Plasma Warhead
summary: Fires only in your Shooting phase, only if the bearer Remained Stationary and did not use its target-marker ability this phase; instead of targeting normally, it attacks every unit within 6" of its target marker.

name: Point-blank Barrage
summary: This unit's ranged attacks against the closest eligible target gain +1 Armour Penetration.

name: Political Overwatch
summary: While another OFFICER model is in this model's unit, you can re-roll Battle-shock tests for that unit.

name: Power Overload
summary: This model re-rolls Damage rolls on attacks against Monster or Vehicle units.

name: Powerful Volley
summary: While affected by an Order and having Remained Stationary this turn, this unit's Heavy weapons gain Lethal Hits.

name: Powerlifter Charge
summary: After this model ends a Charge move, roll a D6 against one enemy unit within Engagement Range: 2-5 deals D3 mortal wounds, 6 deals 3.

name: Precision Drop
summary: When this unit arrives via Deep Strike, it may set up more than 6" from all enemies instead of the normal minimum, but cannot declare a charge that turn.

name: Primed and Ready
summary: In your Shooting phase, target an eligible unit with this ability with the Explosives Stratagem for 0CP (even a second time this phase), if not already targeted by it.

name: Psychic Barrier (Psychic)
summary: At the start of the opponent's Shooting phase, roll a D6: on a 1 this model's unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 2+ that unit has a 4+ invulnerable save until the end of the phase.

name: Rapid Deployment
summary: Units can disembark from this TRANSPORT after it Advances; they count as having made a Normal move and cannot charge that turn, but otherwise act normally.

name: Rapid Strike Vehicle
summary: While one or more units are embarked and this model is not Battle-shocked, its Objective Control characteristic increases by 1 for every 3 embarked models, rounding down.

name: Ratling Battlemutt
summary: Once per battle when selected to shoot, this unit's ranged weapons gain the Lethal Hits ability until the end of the phase.

name: Rearm, Reload, Fire
summary: While affected by an Order and having Remained Stationary this turn, this unit's Heavy weapons gain Sustained Hits 1.

name: Recovery Vehicle
summary: At the end of your Movement phase, this model can repair one friendly Astra Militarum Vehicle within 3": it regains up to D3 lost wounds. Once per model per turn.

name: Regimental Banner
summary: Add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in the bearer's unit.

name: Regimental Standard
summary: Add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in the bearer's unit.

name: Reinforced Cover
summary: A model not fully visible to the attacking unit because of this fortification has the Benefit of Cover against that ranged attack.

name: Remorseless Barrage
summary: After this model shoots, if an Indirect Fire weapon hit an enemy unit, that unit must take a Battle-shock test (Infantry hit by a multiple rocket launcher take that test at -1).

name: Remote Mine
summary: Once per battle, at the start of your Shooting phase, target one enemy unit within 9" of and visible to the bearer and roll a D6: on a 3+ it suffers D3 mortal wounds (2D3 instead against a Vehicle or Fortification).

name: Rolling Fortress
summary: A friendly model not fully visible to the attacking unit because of this model has the Benefit of Cover against that ranged attack.

name: Rugged Reliability
summary: Ranged attacks targeting this model have their Armour Penetration worsened by 1.

name: Screening Line
summary: In your opponent's Movement phase, if an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit and it is not in Engagement Range, it can make a Normal move of up to 6".

name: Senior Officer
summary: While leading a unit, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit gain the Sustained Hits 1 ability.

name: Sentry Programming
summary: You can target this unit with Fire Overwatch for 0CP, even if already used on a different unit this phase.

name: Servo-scribes
summary: Once per battle, when the Lord Commissar issues an Order, it can issue one additional Order.

name: Servo-sentry
summary: When this unit arrives via Deep Strike, the Tempestor Aquilon can shoot with its sentry weapon.

name: Shock Troops
summary: At the end of your Command phase, if this unit is within range of an objective marker you control, you keep control of it, even without models present, until the opponent controls it at the start or end of a turn.

name: Shoot Sharp and Scarper
summary: After this unit shoots, if not in Engagement Range, it can make a Normal move; if it does, it cannot charge this turn.

name: Siege Bombardment
summary: After this unit shoots, pick one hit enemy unit; it must take a Battle-shock test.

name: Slabshield
summary: The bearer has a Wounds characteristic of 7.

name: SNIPER TEAMS
summary: For Transport embarking purposes, each model in this unit counts as one Heavy Weapons Team model.

name: Storm Troopers
summary: This unit's attacks re-roll Wound rolls of 1, or the whole Wound roll instead if targeting a unit within range of an objective marker.

name: Subterranean Assault
summary: Each time this model uses Deep Strike, you can also set up one friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit from Strategic Reserves wholly within 9" of this model and more than 8" from all enemies.

name: Summary Execution
summary: Once per battle round, at the start of any phase, target one Battle-shocked friendly unit within 12" of this model: destroy one model in it and remove its Battle-shock.

name: Support Vehicle
summary: In your Command phase, pick one friendly Vehicle within 3": it regains D3 wounds and re-rolls Hit rolls of 1 until your next Command phase; once per model per phase, not combined with the Omnissiah's Blessing on the same target.

name: Suppression Bombardment
summary: After this model shoots, mark one hit non-Monster/Vehicle enemy unit as suppressed until your next Shooting phase or turn (depending on the model): suppressed units suffer -1 to the Hit roll on their attacks.

name: Tactical Genius
summary: Once per battle round, when a friendly Regiment unit within 12" of this model is targeted by a Stratagem, reduce that Stratagem's cost by 1CP.

name: Tanith Camo-cloaks
summary: Models in this unit have the Benefit of Cover.

name: Tank Hunter
summary: Each time this model's Macharius twin vanquisher cannon attacks a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

name: Tank-killer
summary: This model's vanquisher battle cannon can re-roll the Wound roll against Monster or Vehicle units.

name: Targeting Coordinates
summary: While affected by an Order, this model's Praetor launcher attacks ignore the Hit roll penalty for targeting a unit that is not visible.

name: Tempestor Prime
summary: While this unit includes a Tempestor Prime, ranged weapons equipped by models in it gain the Sustained Hits 1 ability.

name: The Collegiate Astrolex
summary: After deployment, redeploy up to three friendly Astra Militarum units, optionally into Strategic Reserves beyond the normal limit.

name: The Lord Solar
summary: At the start of your Command phase, while this model is on the battlefield, gain 1CP.

name: The Ratling Twins
summary: While this unit contains 2 models, its ranged attacks can re-roll the Hit roll and the Wound roll.

name: Thunderous Head-butt
summary: When this model's unit fights, roll a D6 against one enemy unit within this model's Engagement Range: 2-5 deals D3 mortal wounds, 6 deals D3+3.

name: Titan-killer
summary: Each time this model's volcano cannon attacks a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, that attack gains the Devastating Wounds ability.

name: Tough to Kill
summary: The first time this model is destroyed, at the end of the phase roll a D6: on a 2+ it returns to the battlefield near where it fell, outside enemy Engagement Range, with D3 wounds.

name: Tracking Target
summary: If this model Remained Stationary this turn, its siege mortar gains Anti-Monster 5+ and Anti-Vehicle 5+ when it shoots.

name: Transport Support
summary: After this model shoots, pick one hit enemy unit; until the end of the phase, attacks against it from models that disembarked from this Transport this turn can re-roll the Hit roll.

name: Tremor Quake
summary: Just after choosing a target for this model's named weapon, that unit and every other enemy Infantry unit within 3" of it must take a Battle-shock test.

name: Unstable Payload
summary: When this model's Deadly Demise ability is triggered, units within 6" suffer mortal wounds on a D6 roll of 4+ instead of 6.

name: Urban Warfare
summary: If this model has the Benefit of Cover against a ranged attack, that attack's Damage characteristic is reduced by 1.

name: USING COMMISSAR GRAVES
summary: Your army can only include one model with this ability.

name: Vox-caster
summary: Each time the bearer's unit is targeted by a Stratagem, roll a D6 (+1 if a friendly Officer is within 6"): on a 5+ you gain 1CP.

name: Vox-net
summary: This model can issue Orders to eligible units up to 12" away.

name: Vox-relay Beacon
summary: Place a token outside the enemy deployment zone at battle start; a friendly Regiment unit within 6" of it can receive Orders as if the Officer were within 6". Removed if an enemy ends any phase within 1" of it.

name: Wall of Muscle
summary: Attacks allocated to a model in this unit have their Damage characteristic reduced by 1.

name: War Hymns
summary: While leading a unit, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit gain the Sustained Hits 1 ability.

name: Warrior Elite
summary: Once per battle round, at the start of any phase, this unit can be affected by an additional Order until your next Command phase, on top of any Orders already issued by an Officer this battle round.

name: Well-stocked Supplies
summary: While leading a unit, improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in that unit by 1.

name: Will of Iron
summary: The first time this model is destroyed, at the end of the phase roll a D6: on a 2+ it returns to the battlefield near where it fell, outside enemy Engagement Range, with 3 wounds.

name: Withering Hail
summary: After this model shoots, mark one hit enemy unit (once per phase): friendly Astra Militarum attacks against it gain +1 Armour Penetration for the rest of the phase.

name: Voice of Command
summary: OFFICER models can issue one Order per Command phase (or after disembarking/deploying) to a unit within 6" until your next Command phase: +3" Move, +1 WS, +1 BS, +1 Rapid Fire Attacks, +1 Save, or +1 Leadership/OC.
